lines.zh: 我摸着石壁，一步步往前。
lines.en: I feel along the wall and move forward step by step.

lines.zh: 石头缝里，我慢慢爬出来。
lines.en: Out of a stone crack, I crawl slowly.
The brighter the light, the heavier my legs.
I hug the stone wall, away from the torches.

lines.zh: 我在暗处数着矿灯的余烬。
lines.en: I count the embers of the mine lamps from the dark.

lines.zh: 从矿石缝里，我露出半张脸。
lines.en: I show half a face from the ore seam.
The darker it is, the faster I get.

lines.zh: 我在算你的火把还能烧多久。
lines.en: I'm working out how long your torch will last.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处反了一下光。
lines.en: My eyes catch the light once in the dark.

lines.zh: 火光下我的动作慢了一半。
lines.en: In torchlight my movements are half as fast.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的火把，往后退了半步。
lines.en: I stare at your torch and shrink back half a step.

lines.zh: 矿石缝里的黑，正合我意。
lines.en: The dark in these ore seams suits me.

lines.zh: 你手里的火光照亮了我。
跟随我，享受腐肉的滋味。
靠近些，让我的气息包围你。
lines.en: Come closer, let my presence envelop you.

lines.zh: 黑暗中你无法看见我的利爪。
lines.en: In the dark, you cannot see my claws.
Just a drop of your blood.

lines.zh: 靠近一些，我有东西给你。
lines.en: Come closer, I have something for you.

lines.zh: 石头撞击发出沉闷声响。
你的碰撞激发我的怒火。

lines.en: Echoes from hitting the cave wall.

lines.zh: 你撞碎了我身后的石头。
lines.en: You shattered the stone behind me.

lines.zh: 洞穴的石块阻挡你的路。
撞击洞穴墙壁，灰尘四起。
lines.en: Dust flies from hitting the cave wall.

lines.zh: 撞击声打破了洞穴的寂静。
lines.en: The silence is broken by the impact.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我的警惕心更强。

lines.en: On this level of the mine, I am alone.

lines.zh: 矿洞里回声太多，我喊不准。
lines.en: Too many echoes in the mine; I can't call straight.
The dark cave suits me better.

lines.zh: 我听见另一双脚在碎石上走。
lines.en: I hear another pair of feet on the gravel.

lines.zh: 我在矿脉深处等一个同类。
lines.en: I wait deep in the ore vein for one of my kind.

lines.zh: 石缝里够宽，能容下两个。
lines.en: The stone crack is wide enough for two.

lines.zh: 光一暗，我的速度就上来。
lines.en: When the light drops, my speed rises.

lines.zh: 石头缝里的我，也在等一个伴。
lines.en: In this rock crack, I too wait for a mate.

lines.zh: 骨头上的泥是洞穴给的。
lines.en: Cave dirt comes with the bones.
Hunting for an exit in the rocks.
Tracing the enemy in the dim light.
Hunting for enemies in the dark.
Locking on to prey in the dark.
Locking on to the target in the light.
Searching for prey in the dark.
Scanning for enemies in the light.

lines.zh: 火把的光，让我慢了下来。
你举着火把，反而更好找。
lines.en: Your torch makes you easier to find.

lines.zh: 光照到我，力量就退一半。
lines.en: Light hits me and half my strength drains.

lines.zh: 我把身子往暗处挪，再盯你。
lines.en: I shift into the dark, then watch you.

lines.zh: 石缝里传来回应，不止我一个。
lines.en: Something answers from the cracks. I'm not alone.
The brighter it gets, the slower I move.

lines.zh: 这里够黑，我的力量全回来了。
lines.en: Dark enough here — all my strength is back.

lines.zh: 我等你走进没有光的那段。
lines.en: I wait for you to step into the stretch with no light.
Locking on to the critical point.
I wait for you to put the torch down.

lines.zh: 暗处我最快，你站错地方了。
lines.en: I'm fastest in the dark, and you chose the wrong spot.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞顶，从上面看你。
lines.en: I cling to the ceiling and look down at you.

lines.zh: 你身后的矿洞，比前面黑。
lines.en: The tunnel behind you is darker than the one ahead.

lines.zh: 我在等光照等级掉到零。
lines.en: I am waiting for the light level to hit zero.

lines.zh: 你踩的这块石头，我啃过。
lines.en: I have chewed the stone you're standing on.
The farther from firelight, the faster I get.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，也不够亮。
lines.en: Raise that torch all you like. It isn't enough.
Every two seconds, I get stronger.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，把你撞在石壁上。
lines.en: I lunge and slam you against the stone wall.

lines.zh: 我咬在你的肘上，牙陷进骨缝。
lines.en: I bite your elbow, teeth sinking into the joint.

lines.zh: 我这一拳带着石粉的味道。
lines.en: This punch of mine tastes of stone dust.
The darker the cave, the stronger I get.
You back into the shadows; that suits me fine.
My teeth are packed with limestone grit.
I press you into the rock.
A blow from the dark lands hardest.

lines.zh: 火把一熄，我的速度就回来了。
lines.en: The torch dies, and my speed returns.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，骨头上留着坑。
lines.en: I bite, and leave pits in the bone.

lines.zh: 矿石的味道，混着你的血。
lines.en: The taste of ore, mixed with your blood.
In a cave, I never slow down.

lines.zh: 我从矿石裂缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack in the ore.

lines.zh: 这石头缝里，光越少我越壮。
lines.en: In this rock crack, less light makes me stronger.

lines.zh: 我从不多的光里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of what little light there is.

lines.zh: 洞穴的黑暗里，多了一个影子。
lines.en: A new shadow joins the cave's dark.
The rock splits and I squeeze out.
With weight thirty, I turn up often.

lines.zh: 这里的石头，正好够我藏。
lines.en: There is just enough stone here to hide me.
